reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown distinguish righteous, other-directed indignation, even Christlike, from the self-indulgent passion the wisdom books and James condemn.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Christopher A. Baba's EvilBible.com presses the plain-sense reading that Ephesians 4:26 approves anger while Ecclesiastes, Proverbs, and James flatly disapprove it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Christopher A. Baba, EvilBible.com, "Is it okay to get angry?"

sides.verseText: \"Be angry, and don't sin.\" Don't let the sun go down on your wrath,

sides.snippet: the anger of man doesn't produce the righteousness of God
sides.verseText: for the anger of man doesn't produce the righteousness of God.
